Spring keepers 2027
Six rooms · twelve weeks · no signal

Move across the moon

01 · The residency

Six writers. One island. Twelve weeks without signal, and a lamp that someone has to light every night.

The room

Each keeper gets a whitewashed room in the old crew house, a desk that faces the water, and a stove. Nothing else is asked of the room.

The lamp

The rota is the only rule. One night a week you climb the 117 steps, light the lamp and write the log. Most people say it's the best page they write all week.

The boat

The supply boat comes on Thursdays, weather allowing. It brings bread, letters and, once a season, an editor who reads what you've made.

02 · Seasons

Three ways to be
cut off from the world.

Mar – May

Spring keepers

Long light, nesting terns, the first warm stone of the year. For people starting something.

Sep – Nov

Storm keepers

The sea gets loud and the boat gets late. For people finishing something they're scared of.

Dec – Feb

Winter keepers

Six hours of daylight and a very bright lamp. For poets, mostly. They know why.

03 · From the log

“Wind NW, force 6. Lamp lit 16:52. Wrote the ending I'd been avoiding since March. Gulls unimpressed.”

Keeper's log, night 61

04 · Applications

Write to
the keeper.

Send ten pages and a paragraph about the book you can't finish anywhere else. Spring applications close on 14 February. The residency is free; the boat is not seasick-proof.
